title: Foundry Platform v2.5.0 - Enhanced Performance and New Analytics
summary: This release introduces significant performance improvements and a new analytics dashboard. Users will experience faster load times and better insights into their data workflows.
description: Foundry Platform v2.5.0 brings major enhancements to core platform performance with up to 40% faster query execution. The new analytics dashboard provides real-time insights into data pipeline performance and resource utilization.

new_features.name: Real-time Analytics Dashboard
new_features.description: New dashboard providing insights into data pipeline performance, resource utilization, and query patterns
new_features.impact: Enables better monitoring and optimization of data workflows

new_features.name: Advanced Caching Layer
new_features.description: Intelligent caching system that learns from query patterns
new_features.impact: Up to 40% faster query execution for frequently accessed data

enhancements.name: Query Optimizer
enhancements.description: Improved query optimization algorithms for complex joins and aggregations

enhancements.name: UI Performance
enhancements.description: Reduced initial load time by 25% through code optimization and lazy loading

bug_fixes.issue: Memory leak in long-running data pipelines
bug_fixes.resolution: Fixed resource cleanup in pipeline executor
Standardized date formatting to ISO 8601 across all export formats

deprecations.reason: Superseded by more efficient v2 endpoints
deprecations.alternative: Migrate to API v2 endpoints (migration guide available)

notes: This release has been in beta for 4 weeks with positive feedback from early adopters.
